subject: general
question: Lakshya Sen won the men's singles final at the India Open badminton tournament, 2022 by defeating _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Loh Kean Yew.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Lakshya Sen won the Men's Singles title of the India open 2022 tournament.
 
• He defeated the world champion, Loh Kean Yew of Singapore in straight games.
 
• The men’s doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty defeated the top-seeded pair of Mohammad Ahsan and Hendra Setiawan of Indonesia.
 
• The women's title was won by Busanan Ongbamrungphan of Thailand.
 
 
• She defeated PV Sindhu in the finals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

__
 
• Badminton:

 
 
• Its apex governing body is International Badminton Federation (IBF).
 
• International Badminton Federation (IBF) was established in 1934.
 
 
• It was later renamed as Badminton World Federation (BWF).
 
• Its headquarters are in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
 
 
 
• Badminton Association of India was formed in 1934.
 
 
• Its headquarters is in New Delhi.
 
• Himanta Biswa Sarma is the current president.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The trophy for the international matches was named Thomas Cup after the name of the first president of the IBF Sir George Thomas.
 
• Thomas Cup competition (for men) started in 1948-1949.
 
• Uber Cup Championship (for women) was started in 1956.
